# Carousel

> Slides one after another that swipe and snap with CSS, with Previous, Next and a marker per slide.

`<slab-carousel>` · Disclosure · built on `CSS scroll snap + <button>s`

Docs: https://slab-elements.dev/components/carousel/

## Import

```js
import 'slab-elements/carousel.js';
```

## Usage

```html
<slab-carousel label="Featured">
  <figure>…</figure>
  <figure>…</figure>
  <figure>…</figure>
</slab-carousel>
```

Each child is a slide. The sliding and snapping are CSS scroll snap, which every browser has, so swiping and scrolling work without a script. The buttons are real `<button>`s rather than Chromium's `::scroll-button()` and `::scroll-marker`, so they're named and styled the same way in every browser. Set `autoplay` only when rotation is worth the interruption: it pauses while the carousel is hovered, stops once focus moves into it, doesn't start under reduced motion, and its first button stops and starts it.

## Keyboard

| Key          | What it does                                                                                                   |
| ------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Tab          | Moves through the rotation button, Previous, Next, the slides and the markers. Slides out of view are skipped. |
| Enter, Space | Presses the focused button.                                                                                    |
| Left, Right  | Scrolls the focused slides to the previous or next slide.                                                      |

## Elements

### `<slab-carousel>`

Import `slab-elements/carousel.js` to register it.

A carousel with no visual styles, following the APG carousel pattern: a region of slides, one after another, with buttons to move between them.

The slides are a CSS scroll snap container, so swiping, scrolling and the arrow keys on the focused slides move between them natively, in every browser, and land each slide in place. Previous and Next, a marker button per slide, and a button to start and stop rotation when `autoplay` is set are real `<button>`s, so they're named, focusable and styled the same way everywhere, rather than the `::scroll-button()` and `::scroll-marker` pseudo-elements only Chromium has.

Each slotted element is a slide. It's a `[role=group]` with `aria-roledescription="slide"` and named "1 of 3" and so on, unless it has a role or a name of its own. Slides scrolled out of view are `inert`, so neither focus nor a screenreader lands in one that can't be seen.

`index` is the current slide's, from 0. Previous and Next are `aria-disabled` rather than `disabled` at either end, so focus stays on them, unless `loop` is set, where they wrap. The current slide's marker has `aria-current="true"`.

`autoplay` moves to the next slide every `interval` milliseconds, wrapping at the end, unless the user prefers reduced motion. It pauses while the pointer is over the carousel, and stops for good once focus moves into it, as the APG's carousel does, so a keyboard user isn't moved along mid-slide. The rotation button stops and starts it. The slides are an `aria-live` region while it's stopped, so moving to a slide announces it.

Laying out the slides and snapping them is what a carousel does, so that's functional and done here: each slide is as wide as the carousel. Style the rest through its parts and `:state(first)`, `:state(last)` and `:state(rotating)`.

#### Attributes

| Name               | Type      | Default | Description                                                                                      |
| ------------------ | --------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `label` (required) | `string`  |         | Names the carousel.                                                                              |
| `autoplay`         | `boolean` | `false` | Moves to the next slide every `interval` milliseconds until it's stopped.                        |
| `index`            | `number`  | `0`     | The current slide's, from 0.                                                                     |
| `interval`         | `number`  | `5000`  | How long each slide shows for when `autoplay` is set, in milliseconds.                           |
| `loop`             | `boolean` | `false` | Previous and Next wrap from one end to the other.                                                |
| `next-label`       | `string`  |         | The next button's text and so its accessible name. "Next slide" in English when unset.           |
| `previous-label`   | `string`  |         | The previous button's text and so its accessible name. "Previous slide" in English when unset.   |
| `start-label`      | `string`  |         | The rotation button's text while rotation is stopped. "Start slide rotation" when unset.         |
| `stop-label`       | `string`  |         | The rotation button's text while the slides rotate. "Stop slide rotation" in English when unset. |

#### Properties

| Name                 | Type                                       | Description                                                                                                                         |
| -------------------- | ------------------------------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `markerLabel`        | `(index: number) => string`                | Names each slide's marker, which has no text, from the slide's index. "Slide" and its number in English when unset.                 |
| `slideLabel`         | `(index: number, total: number) => string` | Names each slide without a name of its own, from its index and how many slides there are. "1 of 3" and so on in English when unset. |
| `slides` (read-only) | `Element[]`                                | Its slides, in order.                                                                                                               |

#### Events

| Name     | Type    | Description                                                                |
| -------- | ------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `change` | `Event` | When the user moves to another slide. Setting `index` doesn't dispatch it. |

#### Slots

| Name      | Type      | Description |
| --------- | --------- | ----------- |
| (default) | `Element` | The slides  |

#### CSS parts

| Name       | Description                               |
| ---------- | ----------------------------------------- |
| `carousel` | The region                                |
| `controls` | The rotation, previous and next buttons   |
| `current`  | The current slide's marker                |
| `marker`   | Each slide's marker                       |
| `markers`  | The markers                               |
| `next`     | The button to the next slide              |
| `previous` | The button to the previous slide          |
| `rotation` | The button that starts and stops rotation |
| `slides`   | The scroll snap container of the slides   |

#### CSS states

| Name               | Description                                        |
| ------------------ | -------------------------------------------------- |
| `:state(first)`    | While its first slide shows.                       |
| `:state(last)`     | While its last slide shows.                        |
| `:state(rotating)` | While it's rotating through its slides on its own. |
